caption: The drawing consists of two separate horizontal panels, both of which have a dark brown background and feature decorative botanical motifs in a yellow-gold color. The upper panel is a horizontally elongated, slightly curved rectangle with a central circular fruit flanked by symmetrical branches bearing broad leaves, smaller rounded fruits, and acorns. The lower panel is a straight horizontal rectangle containing three stylized flowers with intricate petals and leaves. The central flower is round and detailed, while the ones on either side are larger with open petals and a smaller round structure at their centers. Each flower is surrounded on both sides by elongated leaves, all rendered in the same yellow-gold color as the rest of the botanical elements.
title: Hitchcock Chair
